entries.en: The fox's craftiness defeats the trapper in the fable.
entries.zh: 寓言里，狐狸靠狡猾战胜了设陷阱的人。

entries.en: The system compared the recording with a stored voiceprint.
entries.zh: 系统把录音与存储的声纹进行了比较。

entries.en: The scan highlighted activity in several subcortical regions.
entries.zh: 扫描显示几个皮质下区域出现活动。

entries.en: She scattered crisp cracklings over the warm bread.
entries.zh: 她把酥脆的油渣撒在温热的面包上。

entries.en: The photograph's graininess became obvious when it was enlarged.
entries.zh: 照片放大后，颗粒状态变得明显。

entries.en: We accepted the temporary arrangement for the nonce.
entries.zh: 我们暂且接受了这个临时安排。

entries.en: The specimen had a damaged ala on one side.
entries.zh: 这件标本一侧的翼受损了。

entries.en: The gang suspected a squealer had revealed their hiding place.
entries.zh: 这伙人怀疑有告密者泄露了他们的藏身处。

entries.en: The inventory listed ribavirin among the antiviral medicines.
entries.zh: 库存清单把利巴韦林列在抗病毒药物之中。

entries.en: The map shows meridional lines crossing the equator.
entries.zh: 这张地图显示了穿越赤道的子午线。

entries.en: Her farewell was quiet and tearless.
entries.zh: 她的告别平静而无泪。

entries.en: The museum documents campaigns against poliomyelitis.
entries.zh: 这家博物馆记录了防治脊髓灰质炎的行动。

entries.en: The duelist lowered his weapon when the challenge was withdrawn.
entries.zh: 挑战被撤回后，决斗者放下了武器。

entries.en: The coating was tested for bactericidal activity.
entries.zh: 这种涂层接受了杀菌活性检测。

entries.en: The abandoned mineshaft was sealed with a steel cover.
entries.zh: 废弃的竖井被钢盖封住了。

entries.en: The surgeon examined the allograft during the follow-up visit.
entries.zh: 外科医生在复诊时检查了同种移植物。

entries.en: The nonagenarian shared memories of the old railway.
entries.zh: 这位九十多岁的人分享了关于旧铁路的回忆。

entries.en: A large comber broke over the rocks.
entries.zh: 一道巨大的卷浪拍碎在礁石上。

entries.en: The authority may decertify operators who fail the inspection.
entries.zh: 主管机构可以收回未通过检查的操作人员的资格证件。

entries.en: The sculpture rests on a conic base.
entries.zh: 这座雕塑安放在一个圆锥形底座上。

entries.en: His piggish demand for every prize annoyed the team.
entries.zh: 他贪心地要求得到每一份奖品，令团队感到恼火。
